definitions: A sudden, often violent, emission or discharge of something (like light, sound, or particles) that spreads out in a semi-circular pattern.
A decorative element or design feature that resembles a semi-circle from which something appears to be erupting or radiating.
examples: The fireworks created a stunning semi-circle burst of color.
We observed a semi-circle burst of energy from the star.
The artist painted a semi-circle burst behind the main figure.
